paper.central_claim: LatentEvolve, a self-evolving latent test-time scaling framework (daytime retrieval + self-supervised latent refinement, nighttime consolidation into a latent weaver), enables LLMs to learn how to scale test-time computation without labels, surpasses TTS methods such as LatentSeek and TTRL by up to 13.33% across eight benchmarks and five backbones, and generalizes across domains and backbones.
paper.title: LatentEvolve: Self-Evolving Test-Time Scaling in Latent Space

signatures.object: Episodic buffer M of (query embedding, base latent z_base, refined latent z*) triplets plus the per-query latent soft-prefix z of a frozen LLM
signatures.information: Frozen LLM final hidden state as query embedding; own sampled outputs scored by the same LLM (self-reward Q); no ground truth, no external verifier
signatures.operation: Top-k cosine retrieval, z0 = z_base + sum_j alpha_j (z*_j - z_base,j), then up to K=10 REINFORCE-style updates on z with M=8 samples
signatures.output: Refined z* used to produce the final answer; triplet archived
signatures.conditions: Archive only if mean Q of last refinement >= tau=0.5
signatures.feedback: Self-judged Q (correctness, comprehension, calculation, format x2, clarity x2)
signatures.selection_rule: Self-confidence threshold tau=0.5; no external check; buffer growth/forgetting not described
signatures.persistence: Buffer M of latent vectors on disk/memory across the test stream
signatures.later_use: Retrieved for later queries in the same evolving stream
signatures.claimed_effect: Daytime component improves accuracy (w/o Daytime SciBench -4.9)
signatures.failure_boundary: Self-judge errors enter buffer unchecked; unfaithful/format-driven reward possible; sensitivity to L' and T reported

signatures.object: Latent weaver W_psi (Qwen2.5-1.5B) that predicts z* from (embedding, z_base) and replaces the base initial latent
signatures.information: Archived triplets only; trained every T=200 test instances
signatures.operation: MSE regression distillation of buffer experience into auxiliary-model weights ('nighttime consolidation')
signatures.output: z'_base = W_psi(e, z_base) feeding daytime scaling
signatures.conditions: Triggered after enough admitted triplets accumulate
signatures.selection_rule: None beyond tau gate; no validation of the updated weaver before use, no rollback
signatures.persistence: Auxiliary-model weights (backbone frozen) -> boundary case: touches weights of a side component
signatures.later_use: Every later query passes through the weaver first
signatures.claimed_effect: w/o Nighttime SciBench -6.8; nighttime transfers better cross-domain (JAMA +4.5 vs +0.4)
signatures.failure_boundary: Large T (1000) loses benefit; weaver only validated on frozen LLM; dimension mapping across backbones not described

gap.author_gap: TTS methods treat queries as independent, so LLMs do not learn to scale test-time compute better with experience.
gap.checked_gap: Holds for latent TTS (LatentSeek, SoftCoT) where each query is optimized from scratch; overbroad for the family because parametric test-time training and explicit experience memories already accumulate across a stream.
gap.lineage: Coconut/SoftCoT -> LatentSeek (per-query latent optimisation via self-reward) -> LatentEvolve (adds retrieval buffer + distilled weaver); parallel line: Reflexion/Mind Evolution, TTT, experience databases (listed in related work).
closest_adjacent: TTRL (test-time RL across stream; weight-updating, our_inference from external knowledge)
explicit-text experience databases named in Sec 2 but not run as baselines
gap.residue: Latent-space accumulation avoids text context growth, but its advantage over explicit memories at equal compute is unmeasured.
gap.stakes: Per-query compute (K*M rollouts) is large; claimed benefit is accuracy and shorter answers (Table 5).
gap.method_response: Retrieval of past optimisation momentum plus a periodically distilled initializer.
gap.remaining_gap: No explicit-memory or compute-matched latent baseline; self-judge validity untested; stream-order sensitivity unknown.
unresolved: Whether TTRL/explicit-memory methods are the fairer nearest neighbors (not locally pinned; no external search allowed)

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Self-scored generate-filter-retrain of a latent initializer corresponds to H28 variant (a): validated context (latent traces) internalized into a small learned component while the backbone stays frozen.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: H28 expects externally grounded reward and a clean held-out split; here reward is self-judged and the stream is the test set. Weights touched are an auxiliary 1.5B model, not the task model.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Retrieving prior latent traces as conditioning for a new query corresponds to retrieve-and-adapt of precedent (momentum transfer is the adaptation).
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: Precedents are latent vectors rather than raw cases; no store-off-with-loop comparison against simple retrieval.

claims.text: LatentEvolve surpasses SOTA TTS methods (LatentSeek, TTRL) by up to 13.33% and beats RL baselines.
claims.setting: Table 1: Qwen2.5-7b and Llama3.2-3b, 8 benchmarks, 13 baselines, Pass@1 at temperature 0, single run
claims.baseline_control: Vanilla, CoT, RL (trained on train splits), latent reasoning, TTS incl. TTRL
claims.selection_vs_test: Evolution on the scored test set (no split); RL baselines use train splits
claims.allowed_conclusion: On par with or slightly above TTRL on most cells (mostly <=2 points, two AIME cells below), clearly above weak latent baselines; stated 'up to 13.33% over TTRL' is not supported.

claims.text: Daytime and nighttime scaling are both indispensable; nighttime yields more transferable knowledge.
claims.setting: w/o Daytime, w/o Nighttime (Fig 4, backbone unspecified in text); Fig 3 sequential MATH->MMLU study on Gemma-3-12b
claims.baseline_control: Full system; no alternative consolidator or gate-off
claims.selection_vs_test: Same stream; OOD tasks GPQA/JAMA held-out in domain
claims.result_denominator: SciBench -4.9 / -6.8; JAMA +4.5 vs +0.4 after first night
claims.allowed_conclusion: Both components contribute in the shown ablation; one-backbone, single-run evidence that nighttime consolidation transfers to other domains.

claims.text: LatentEvolve evolves without labels or external signals.
claims.setting: Self-reward Q from the same LLM; tau=0.5 gate
claims.result_denominator: no judge-accuracy or ground-truth-gated variant reported
claims.allowed_conclusion: Label-free operation is demonstrated; that the self-signal tracks correctness (rather than format) is not.

assessment.evidence_level_note: Weak: the nighttime-consolidated weaver and buffer improve later and out-of-domain queries in one backbone's Fig 3 study; in-domain results are on the evolving stream itself, so they alone would be 'task'.
assessment.scope_note: In scope as a boundary case: the retained non-weight store is the episodic latent buffer (plus latent soft-prefix optimisation on a frozen backbone); the nighttime weaver is an auxiliary 1.5B model trained on test-stream experience (rubric A3: evaluated object is non-weight store; H28 boundary pattern).
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Adding a latent episodic buffer and a periodically distilled initializer to LatentSeek-style self-rewarded latent optimisation raises accuracy over vanilla/CoT across 8 benchmarks, roughly matching TTRL (mostly <=2 points), with one-backbone evidence of cross-domain carry-over.
unresolved: Compute-matched comparison; stream-order variance; validity of the self-reward; ablation backbone; effect without the format-heavy reward

G.reason: Real gap for latent TTS (LatentSeek/SoftCoT are per-query), but 'TTS lacks evolution' is overbroad: weight-updating test-time methods are acknowledged (E003) and no explicit-memory self-evolving baseline is compared; residual bottleneck not measured.

M.reason: Concrete two-timescale mechanism (momentum transfer from buffer, weaver distillation); the claim that momentum beats averaging final latents and that latent deltas transfer across queries is asserted, not tested.

X.reason: Main steps and hyperparameters (L'=15, tau=0.5, T=200, K=10, M=8) are given, but top-k value, buffer size/forgetting, injection point of z, weaver-to-backbone dimension mapping and rollback are not; retention gate is self-score only.

E.measurement.reason: Benchmarks are standard, but the self-reward puts 4/7 weight on format/clarity and vanilla MMLU is far below CoT; gains vs 'vanilla' mix format repair with learning; AIME vanilla=0.00 under 2048-token cap.

E.causality.reason: Day/night component ablations exist (E016-17) and Qwen2.5-7b is compared to 13 baselines, but no gate-off, no averaging-vs-momentum control, no compute-matched latent-optimisation-only baseline; vs TTRL margins are mostly <=2 pts.

E.holdout.reason: In-domain accuracy is measured on the stream the system evolves on (no declared split); a one-backbone OOD transfer study (E018-19) is the only held-out evidence; ablation backbone unspecified; no contamination analysis.

E.statistics.reason: Sample sizes stated (30-problem AIME, 1000-item MMLU subset) and several cells are ties/losses to TTRL, but single deterministic run, no seeds, intervals or stream-order variance.

E.cost.reason: Cost is limited to final answer length vs CoT; per-query K*M rollouts, weaver training and buffer retrieval are neither costed nor compute-matched against baselines.
